programmes.d: Journalists Bill Turnbull and Louise Minchin get help from Philip Serrell and David Barby.
A very old clock is ticking for Tim at Salisbury Cathedral on the last leg of his trip with Irita. She's currently out in front but could he become the tortoise to her hare?
James Braxton and Charles Hanson are heading across the Solent to the Isle of Wight in search of bargains, and Charles finds a bit of history.
Antiques dealer Paul Martin makes his Road Trip debut alongside seasoned tripper Raj Bisram. A mysterious giant and very cute dog also feature in this South Downs adventure.
James Braxton and Charles Hanson are battling it out along the Dorset and Devon coast--and there's a big surprise at the auction in Torquay.
Neil Stuke and Penny Smith head out with Paul Laidlaw and Thomas Plant.
It's day four and James Braxton and Charles Hanson are heading for Cornwall, where Charles has an enchanting experience and James goes to the fair.
The Road Trip continues in Wiltshire for debutant Paul Martin and seasoned chum Raj Bisram. Will a gamble buy of antique jelly moulds cause an auction wobble for one expert?
Laila Rouass and Charles Dale shop around England with James Lewis and Paul Laidlaw.
James Braxton and Charles Hanson head deep into Cornwall on the last day of their road trip. James goes to church before the final auction in Truro.
Raj Bisram and Paul Martin explore antique shops in the West Country. At auction an expensive biscuit tin leaves a foul taste while a cheap oil painting makes an impression.
David Harper and David Barby help former gold medalists Robin Cousins and Tessa Sanderson.
It's a new road trip! Anita Manning and Philip Serrell are touring the north of England in their classic car, aiming for a profit in Edinburgh.
Antiques expert chums, Raj Bisram and Paul Martin take their open-topped motor to Dorset, Devon, Somerset and beyond. Will they make profits at the Worcestershire auction?
As Anita Manning and Philip Serrell head to auction in County Durham, Philip develops an odd interest in sewing and Anita eyes up a wedding dress.
A hot rod, two experts and a boot full of antiques….let the battle commence!
Raj Bisram and Paul Martin reach Shakespeare country, to buy or not to buy? Plus, they meet alpacas and do some ballet. Expect Incas, tutus and tights.
Phil and Natasha scour Scotland, but can a mannequin head outclass wooden oars?
Anita Manning and Philip Serrell get the bit between their teeth as they head through the Dales and make the most of its horse racing history.
A new Road Trip sees Steven Moore find some pricey porcelain in an antique shop loo, while Natasha Raskin Sharp disappears down a secret tunnel on a journey back in time.
In a Road Trip first, Phil is so impressed he pays more than the ticket price!
On day four of their trip Anita Manning and Philip Serrell head for the bright lights of Blackpool and can't resist a visit to the pleasure beach.
Northumberland sees Natasha on safari tracking ancient creatures while Steven finds an old elephant. Both experts go Georgian with their treasures going under the gavel in Dundee.
Natasha goes glassy eyed for a tiny glass, while it’s ‘TIMBER’ for Phil.
Anita Manning and Philip Serrell go head-to-head at an auction in Harrogate on this final day of their road trip.
Phil and Natasha go all out in this final auction duel!
Steven and Natasha visit the Scottish Borders. They reveal the hidden past of the Roman Empire and an antique hiding a secret. Expect more surprises at the Edinburgh auction.
Experts Mark Stacey and Mark Hales battle it out in the auction rooms and antiques shops of eastern England in a race to turn an unbeatable profit.
Danny Sebastian buckles up for his first road trip taking on veteran Irita Marriott.
In the battle of the two Marks, Mark Stacey and Mark Hales make some surprising investments as they make their way from Rutland to Norfolk.
The Scottish antique buying adventure continues for Steven and Natasha. The pricey purchase of some militaria proves costly, and an unassuming lantern attracts big bids.
Saddle up for with rookie Danny versus veteran Irita in the Wild West…of England.
On the third day of their road trip Mark Stacey visits the magnificent Ely Cathedral and his opponent Mark Hales gets excited about a sketchbook.
A trip through Scotland sees Natasha get to grips with haggis and Steven falls for an exquisite French lady. It's the last auction of this adventure, who will take Road Trip crown?
Irita may be the master, but Danny is no apprentice as they zip across Oxfordshire.
Road trippers Mark Stacey and Mark Hales head for East Anglia in their classic car as the battle to win intensifies between them.
A new adventure for Izzie Balmer and Philip Serrell, who scour the shops of Kent in search of antiques. Expect rocking horse riding, cat whispering and disagreements about scarves.
Irita finds the saddest looking doggy in the world, but will it cheer her up at auction?
In this final day of their 300-mile road trip, Mark Hales gets a lesson in spying and Mark Stacey is left stunned at the auction.
Back on the road with Izzie Balmer and Phil Serrell as they hunt for elusive antique treasures. A gamble on some brown furniture may prove profitable at the Hertfordshire auction.
It all comes down to a job-lot of cars in Danny Sebastian’s last shot with Irita Marriott.
It's time for Thomas Plant and James Lewis to take their classic car bargain hunting around the highlands and lowlands of Scotland.
Izzie Balmer and Phil Serrell are driving through a downpour in Oxfordshire on the trail of treasures. Will a long-lost saucer or designer brooch most excite the Harrogate auction?
Experts Izzie Balmer and James Braxton have a smashing good time in Derbyshire.
Experts Thomas Plant and James Lewis pick up some very unusual items as they travel across Scotland from west to east coast in their classic car.
The football gloves are off as James and Izzie return for round two.
Gloves off and weapons at the ready as experts Izzie Balmer and Philip Serrell scour the shops of Staffordshire and Shropshire. But who will be left standing at the auction?
Thomas Plant takes a financial gamble and James Lewis talks to animals on the third leg of their trip around Scotland.
James hopes his mystery boxes will eclipse Izzie at auction.
There's more car trouble for experts Thomas Plant and James Lewis on the fourth leg of their tour of Scotland.
It's the final face-off for Izzie Balmer and Phil Serrell as they search the shops of Lincolnshire for bargains. A hefty horticultural item and delicate posy holder go to auction.
James tries to even the scores while Izzie is locked behind bars.
In the final leg of their trip Thomas Plant trades four wheels for two and James Lewis gets to the root of popular New Year's anthem Auld Lang Syne.
In Wales, Izzie Balmer and Tim Medhurst search for antiques to sell at auction. Izzie gets in a spin about a chair while Tim's inner child comes alive when he finds three toy cars.
Izzie’s keen on a very old cup of tea, while James shows his risqué side!

Charlie Ross and Catherine Southon to hit the road in their classic car on a 200-mile journey to out-buy each other and outdo each other at auction. They begin in Corsham in the heart of Wiltshire and finish with an auction in Devizes.
Izzie Balmer and Tim Medhurst scour Wales for antiques to sell at auction. Izzie keeps it local with a traditional outfit and Tim roars with delight over a lion-shaped pin cushion.
New expert Tahmina hopes a sword and jelly mould will wobble David at auction.
It's day two for Charlie Ross and Catherine Southon as they cosy up on their rain-swept journey criss-crossing southern England in the hunt for antiques to sell at an auction in Wareham, Dorset.
Izzie Balmer and Tim Medhurst search for antiques to sell at auction in Wales. Izzie finds an ornament from the WWI trenches and Tim discovers some chocolate that's 100 years old.
Tahmina, David and the dizzying heights of Tyne Bridge -- but who will summit at auction?
Day three of their jaunt finds Catherine Southon and Charlie Ross wending their way along the south coast, headed for a shock at the auction in Lewes.
Antiques experts Izzie Balmer and Tim Medhurst hope to make big profits when they sell their wares in Wales. Izzie finds her way to some maps and Tim's made up about a medal.
Tahmina Ghaffar and David Harper have gone fishing for antiques around the fens.
As Charlie Ross and Catherine Southon battle it out on day four, they take in some history on their trip from the south coast of England to London.
Tahmina and David hone-in on exotic antiques but will they dazzle at auction?
It's crunch time in Wales for our antiques experts. At the final auction, Izzie Balmer pins her hopes on two auspicious vases while Tim Medhurst hopes that his letter box delivers.
It's the final showdown for Charlie Ross and Catherine Southon as they embark on their last journey in the classic car, heading for auction in Rye.
No one said antique buying involved eating insect burgers!
It's the start of a brand-new series as Thomas Plant and Philip Serrell team up for a 700-mile trip beginning in Lancashire and the Isle of Man.
James Braxton and Irita Marriott cruise through Kent in a classic car. James spots a child's rattle that sparks international interest, while Irita's hopes rest on a damaged lamp.
Fresh off the ferry, Roo Irvine and David Harper go full throttle in Northern Ireland.
Philip Serrell thinks "big is best" on his shopping trip with rival expert Thomas Plant as they journey from York to Rotherham in search of a bargain.
James Braxton and Irita Marriott shop along England's south coast. James buys high value items with his wedge of cash, but Irita makes some canny purchases in a bid to close the gap.
From a radioactive treasure to a sculpture with bite, Belfast welcomes Roo and David.
Thomas Plant gets to ride in a special classic car and Philip Serrell has his eye on a unique lady, as they make their way through the Peak District.
An old beer bottle and a fish kettle whet James's appetite for profits in East Sussex and Hampshire, while Irita hopes a 19th century puzzle box solves her auction woes.
Roo Irvine and David Harper go wild in Scotland with treasure, transport and mollusks.

Antiquers James Braxton and Irita Marriott rummage around the antique shops of Wiltshire and Dorset. Will porcelain or brass bring the experts riches at auction?
From antiques to football feats, Roo and David chase auction glory in northwest England.
